title: Western Railway halts demolition in Mumbai's Prabhadevi amid protest

ai.summary: Western Railway temporarily halted demolition of 102 unauthorized structures in Mumbai's Prabhadevi after residents protested for alternative accommodation, citing decades-long habitation and lack of rehabilitation.

facts.claim: Western Railway temporarily halted demolition of 102 unauthorized structures in Mumbai's Prabhadevi
facts.quote: Western Railway halts demolition in Mumbai's Prabhadevi amid protest

facts.claim: The demolition of encroachments has been temporarily postponed and that a comprehensive policy will be formulated
facts.quote: the demolition of encroachments has been temporarily postponed and that a comprehensive policy will be formulated

facts.claim: Residents staged a protest by sitting and lying in front of the JCB machinery, forcing officials to stop the operation
facts.quote: Residents staged a protest by sitting and lying in front of the JCB machinery, forcing officials to stop the operation

facts.claim: The demolition drive aimed to clear two chawls and several ground-floor and one-floor rooms to make way for residential quarters for railway employees
facts.quote: The demolition drive aimed to clear two chawls and several ground-floor and one-floor rooms to make way for residential quarters for railway employees

facts.claim: Residents, many of whom claim to have lived in the area for nearly five decades, have demanded alternative accommodation before being asked to vacate their homes
facts.quote: Residents, many of whom claim to have lived in the area for nearly five decades, have demanded alternative accommodation before being asked to vacate their homes

facts.claim: Residents have appealed to the authorities to take an early decision on rehabilitation and ensure that families who have lived in the area for decades are not displaced without alternative housing
facts.quote: They have appealed to the authorities to take an early decision on rehabilitation and ensure that families who have lived in the area for decades are not displaced without alternative housing

ai.background_note: Residents in Mumbai's Prabhadevi have been living in the area for nearly 50 years and demand alternative accommodation before being displaced by railway land reclamation efforts.
